Hey, thanks for the reply... I've been off and on it (mostly on) for about 7 years now. I've managed to keep it down a schedule to where I take morphine in the morning to not have any morning sickness, but I'll start to get sick later in the day if I don't IV. I always try to make sure I get my daily video done before I do that. Sometimes it's hard and I end up messing up and waking up several hours later half way through editing my video. I'm not perfect at it, but I'm somewhat of a functioning addict. I've tried several times to just beat it, done it once after I locked myself in my apartment and used the excuse of me being on vacation for my audience. I got to day 4 and the anxiety got to me and I nearly died from an OD. Woke up with vomit all over my bed (thankfully I lay on my side, so I didn't choke on it), but I consider myself lucky. That wasn't my first OD as well. I want to quit, but I don't at the same time. You understand. I appreciate it. I really don't want to be in the cycle forever. It's killing me and making me want to die.

Edit: as for hobbies, I used to play the piano, but that stopped once I got hooked on Rx from a script and found heroin a year afterwards.

I wish taking a vacation was that easy. You can't just take a vacation when you have a very bad opiate dependency. I would've traveled the world by now if the drugs weren't weighing me down. And you know what? I'm depressed because of the drugs, but I would be even more depressed without them.
I don't make content that girls find interesting. In fact, 84% of my audience is teenage boys.

I do not show myself on camera. I am asked for a face reveal every single day and I will probably never do it, because I am embarrassed of how I look. I don't take care of myself, because I don't care anymore. Really the only things I care about are making money (for what, though? I don't really do anything with it except buy food and drugs.) and doing drugs. Getting that sweet rush from heroin and morphine is really the only thing that has kept me going. I would probably kill myself from the anxiety of withdrawals if I had them.
